entries.content:
Read spec + `search_control.tsx`, `search_launcher.tsx`, `search_panel.tsx`, and tests. Plan below. No edits yet.

## Root causes
1. **Escape reopens.** User presses Escape → MUI `Popover` closes → Popover puts focus back on launcher `TextField` → launcher `onFocus={onOpen}` fires → `openSearch` runs → popover open again.
2. **Resize loses results/options.** Width change flips `usesPopover` → `SearchControl` unmounts inline `SearchPanel`, mounts popover `SearchPanel`. New panel starts with `mode='text'`, both toggles `false`, `results=EMPTY_RESULTS`. Only `query` survives (lifted in `SearchControl`), and panel never runs search on mount, so results empty.

## Change Plan

**Block 1: no reopen after Escape** (`search_control.tsx`)
- Add `disableRestoreFocus` to `Popover`. Close no longer refocuses launcher → no `onFocus` → stays closed. Later click/Tab/shortcut still open it.
- Launcher `onFocus` untouched (Tab-to-open keeps working).

**Block 2: keep options + results across presentation switch** (`search_control.tsx`, `search_panel.tsx`)
- `SearchControl` keeps one `searchOptions` state `{ mode, includeBackgroundBody, includeActions }` next to `query`. Passes `initialOptions` + `onOptionsChange` to both `SearchPanel` branches. Same pattern `query` uses today.
- `SearchPanel` sets its state from `initialOptions`. Each toggle and agent result (agent switches mode to `regexp`) calls `onOptionsChange`.
- `SearchPanel` runs `applySearch(initialQuery, …initialOptions)` once in mount effect. Effect, not render, because invalid RegExp errors go through `dialogService`. Remounted panel then shows same results.
- Possible issue: lint rule `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` may flag `setResults` in that effect. If so, I tell you before picking workaround. No rule override.
- Alternative: move search state into service (AGENTS.md says app state belongs in services). Bigger change. Not recommended for this bug.

**Block 3: tests** (`search_control.test.tsx`)
- Shortcut presentation: click launcher → Escape → popover gone, stays gone; click launcher again → reopens.
- Type `Beta` inline → rerender `icon` → query + `Beta feature` result still there; rerender `full` → still there.
- Enable RegExp + background-body + actions toggles → resize → toggles still `aria-pressed`, background-body result (`secret` → `History note`) still found.
- Run with `npm run test -- src/components/shell/search/search_control.test.tsx`, plus `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`.

**Block 4: status** in `C:\Users\janbo\Documents\dev\md2\design\feature_descriptions\B_259_…md`: `ready for implementation` → `ready`.

## Tasks
- [ ] T1: Popover `disableRestoreFocus`
- [ ] T2: lift search options + apply initial search on mount
- [ ] T3: regression tests + lint/typecheck
- [ ] T4: set spec `status: ready`

No task-tracking tool in this session, so tasks live in this list. Approve?
